preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 500 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of friends N is between 1 and 500 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(is_valid_time(P) for P in [input().strip() for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each meeting time P is a valid time in the 12-hour clock format.

preconditions.expression: all(all(is_valid_time(Li) and is_valid_time(Ri) for Li, Ri in [input().strip().split() for _ in range(N)]) for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each friend's availability times Li and Ri are valid times in the 12-hour clock format.

preconditions.expression: all(all(convert_to_24(Li) <= convert_to_24(Ri) for Li, Ri in [input().strip().split() for _ in range(N)]) for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: For each friend, the end time Ri is not earlier than the start time Li in the 24-hour clock format.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output) == N for output, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a string of length N.

postconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in output) for output in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(''.join('1' if convert_to_24(P) >= convert_to_24(Li) and convert_to_24(P) <= convert_to_24(Ri) else '0' for Li, Ri in [input().strip().split() for _ in range(N)]) == output for output, P, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [input().strip() for _ in range(T)], [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string indicates whether the corresponding friend can attend the meeting based on their availability.
